about: Evidence lenses the app loads. One entry per model bundle in this directory (test-vector files excluded); tests/lenses.test.mjs fails if a bundle is missing here. 'adapter' says which form mapping scores it (see FORM_ADAPTERS in couple.js); a lens without one is listed with its population, target and skill but gives no number.

lenses.label: NLSY79 married individuals, each partner's own traits (U.S., born 1957–64, observed 2000–2022)
NLSY79 first marriages from the wedding (U.S., born 1957–64, weddings 1981–2022; legal divorce)
NSFG 2002 women's first marriages (U.S., weddings 1972–2002, from the wedding day)
NSFG 2002 women's first marriages: logistic hazard, naive Bayes, random forest and gradient boosting
GSS panels 2006–2020: married adults, divorced or separated 2 years later (U.S., prospective; includes marriage happiness)
HCMST couples, married and unmarried, incl. same-sex (U.S., 2009–2017; break-up per follow-up period)
Los Angeles newlyweds: observed conflict, satisfaction and divorce over 12 years (368 couples, 2009–2022)
Fair's Redbook survey: affairs reported by 6,366 married women (U.S., 1974; not divorce)
Fair's Psychology Today survey: affairs reported by 601 married men and women (U.S., 1969; not divorce)
